description: The bar chart presents a quantitative comparison of performance across four benchmark datasets—MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics—evaluating three models: SRPO-7B (dark blue), GRPO-7B (medium blue), and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B (light blue). The vertical axis, labeled "Score," ranges from 35 to 80 in increments of 5, representing the performance score on each benchmark. For each benchmark, three bars are grouped together, with the legend indicating that the dark blue bar corresponds to SRPO-7B, the medium blue to GRPO-7B, and the light blue to Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. In MathVista, SRPO-7B achieves the highest score of 75.8, followed by GRPO-7B at 72.3 and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B at 68.2. In MathVerse, SRPO-7B scores 55.8, GRPO-7B scores 52.9, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 46.3. For MMMU-Pro, SRPO-7B scores 42.3, GRPO-7B scores 39.9, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 36.9. In Physics, SRPO-7B scores 60.6, GRPO-7B scores 53.5, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 45.4. Across all benchmarks, SRPO-7B consistently outperforms both GRPO-7B and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B, with the largest performance gap observed in the MathVista benchmark.
